sloka: ततस्तेनैव मार्गेण प्रत्युत्तीर्य्य नदीतटात् ।आरुरोह नरव्याघ्रो रम्यसानुं महीधरम् ॥ २.१०२.३१॥
transliteration: tatastenaiva mārgeṇa pratyuttīryya nadītaṭāt ।āruroha naravyāghro ramyasānuṁ mahīdharam ॥ 2.102.31॥

translations.english: Rama, the tiger among men, ascending the riverbank and proceeding on the same path (he had come), climbed the (Chitrakuta) mountain of charming slopes.
